data.one_liner: Widget that enables users to resize internal child widgets by dragging separators.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to resize internal child widgets dynamically by dragging separators between them. Supports custom separator sizes, colors, initial percentages, and a smart-hide feature upon double-clicking.
use_when: You need split-pane or resizable layouts inside your app.
You want users to adjust the relative screen space allocated to different sections.
avoid_when: You need complex docking layouts or multi-window desktop management.
You only need a static layout grid.
strengths: Supports callbacks to track size and percentage changes.
Includes customizable separator color, size, and smart-hide functionality.
weaknesses: Limited to linear resizable splits of internal widgets.
No advanced nesting or dockable window features mentioned.
data.minimal_example:
ResizableWidget(
  children: [
    Container(color: Colors.greenAccent),
    Container(color: Colors.yellowAccent),
    Container(color: Colors.redAccent),
  ],
  isHorizontalSeparator: false,
  percentages: [0.2, 0.5, 0.3],
)
